scope: Arbitrum gUSDC exact liquidity vault: direct deposit/mint, epoch withdrawal request/cancel and withdraw/redeem, discounted NFT-locked deposit/mint and matured NFT unlock, plus fixed no-argument epoch progress request. gDAI sunset excluded; no trading, OTC, arbitrary callbacks/executors, other collateral, role or permit admission.

lifecycleEvidence.evidence: Official current deployment table lists gUSDC on Arbitrum; official gUSDC app describes ongoing USDC deposits and fee counterparty liquidity. Official changelog has 2026-10-20 release and 2026-10-13 vault balance/APR update; 2026-09-21 explicitly leads vaults with gUSDC. These are maintenance/product evidence, not DAU or vaultTVL evidence. No gUSDC retirement notice in reviewed sources. gDAI has an explicit Sunset banner and is excluded separately.

deploymentEvidence.evidence: Official exact address bound to Sourcify EIP1967Proxy resolution reporting current implementation 0xeb754588efF264793bb80Be65866D11Bc8d6CBdD. Initial constructor implementation 0x1f7effff1535dfdbe3eda57a514a7f6391b1d9d6 is not substituted for resolved implementation. Constructor initialization bytes contain native USDC asset; not a fresh asset getter or storage attestation. Arbiscan target reads were HTTP 403, so no explorer match or implementation claim is inferred from them.

selectedFunctions.label: Cancel gUSDC withdrawal request
warnings: Arbitrum One gUSDC only, native USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831 (6 decimals). gUSDC is not USDC, gDAI or a guaranteed 1:1 claim. Deposits require separate USDC allowance to this exact vault; approvals are not admitted here.

Vault liquidity is counterparty capital for leveraged trades: trader PnL, insolvency, oracle, smart-contract and upgrade/governance risks can cause loss. No APY, vault TVL or DAU claim is established by this review.

Withdrawals are not immediate: makeWithdrawRequest takes share units and sets an unlock epoch 1/2/3 epochs ahead according to collateralization. withdraw/redeem consume only the current-epoch request and are unavailable during an open-PnL request window. Missing the window requires a new request; current epoch timing must be rechecked.

Discount-lock flows require active nonzero discount, permitted duration and positive computed discount or revert. They mint an NFT while shares stay in the vault. unlockDeposit requires NFT ownership/approval, maturity and solvency checks and returns shares, not underlying USDC. USDC withdrawal still needs the normal request/epoch flow.

Amounts use raw asset/share units; receiver, owner, unlockEpoch and depositId are distinct and must refer to the intended account/request. Requests can restrict share transfers. A third party requesting/cancelling or withdrawing on an owner requires appropriate allowance.

The epoch helper cannot force a successful update: it catches configured feed-call failure and may succeed without advancing the epoch. No arbitrary callback, PnL settlement, administration, generic executor, permit, or other vault/chain is authorized.

Published deployment, ABI and source evidence only: Sourcify proxy and implementation report exact_match. No fresh RPC runtime-code/implementation attestation, simulation, funding, liquidity or execution guarantee. Geographic/legal eligibility and protocol restrictions must be respected; catalog membership does not bypass independent authorization, pause or signing controls.
